verdict.rationale: Unity ships an official in-editor AI Assistant package (com.unity.ai.assistant) for creating assets, automating workflows, analyzing performance and performing project actions from natural-language prompts. Credits docs also confirm in-product image, 3D model and sound-effect generation alongside Assistant messaging. It is still beta/pre-release (2.20.0-pre.1) and metered via Unity Credits. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of script generation and API question answering, scene scaffolding specifics, independent hands-on corroboration, and a stable non-beta release.
